title: Analysis of curative-intent interstitial HDR brachytherapy for renal tumors
summary:
The aim of this study is to demonstrate that interstitial HDR brachytherapy represents an oncologically successful, low-complication, and technically highly feasible therapeutic alternative for the treatment of renal cell carcinomas. 
It is based on the results of the predecessor study (BREM-I).

interventions.name: This study is based on the predecessor study (BREM-I) and includes all patients undergoing interstitial HDR brachytherapy for histologically confirmed renal cell carcinoma at our institution between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2027.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- available, prospectively obtained written informed consent for the evaluation of data for scientific purposes
- histologically confirmed renal cell carcinoma
- Patient age over 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients under 18 years of age
- Pregnancy or other contraindications to CT imaging
